chapter: Neighborhood halls and the Ida Cox tour
title: Visitor joins; first out-of-town job with Kid Howard
summary: A visitor arrives; Joseph says his first out-of-town job, in Bucklewood, Louisiana, was with Kid Howard.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: How you doing? How in? I was just talking about, um, Sprox has a, uh, once toured with Ida Cox, the blues singer, and she got up the band here in New Orleans. Oh, here in New Orleans?
I'll tell you something else too, man. My first job out of town in Bucklewood, Louisiana was with Kid Howard, man. Oh, really?
Oh, I don't know, man. Really, I'd forgotten. I can't keep up. You were a young man, huh?
